title: H3011 (125th General Assembly): Firearms criminal background checks

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2022-12-08; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess125_2023-2024/prever/3011_20221208.htm (LegiScan doc 2617373))
provenance.note: Introduced 2022-12-08. Applies to sales by licensed dealers only; no penalty clause. Passage vote: none listed; introduced text only.

operative_text: Section 1 (new Section 23-31-70): (B) Before any sale, exchange, or transfer pursuant to the provisions of this article may take place in this State, a national instant criminal background check pursuant to 18 U.S.C. Section 922 must be completed by a licensed dealer. Notwithstanding another provision of law, a licensed dealer may not deliver a firearm to a purchaser or transferee until the results of all required background checks are known and the purchaser or transferee is not prohibited from owning or possessing a firearm pursuant to the provisions of 18 U.S.C. Section 922 or any other local, state, or federal law and the licensed dealer has been notified.
